context: Designed (design-only, no code changed) the plugin-bundled-server workaround for node-without-npm environments: esbuild single-file bundle committed at plugin/server/twining-server.mjs + plugin/server/public/, launched via sh -lc login shell running plugin/server/launch.sh with fallback ladder TWINING_SERVER_JS override > project-local ./node_modules/twining-mcp/dist/index.js > bundled file; npx removed from the plugin launch path entirely. Release: bundle rebuilt at release points by bump-plugin-version.sh, CI freshness-diff + stdio boot smoke test guard the committed artifact.
rationale: this resolves the open v2.1 need about plugin-bundled vs project-pinned dual servers structurally: projects pin by installing twining-mcp as a devDependency and the plugin launcher honors it, so no root .mcp.json twining entry and no exact-command denies are needed. Rejected bundled-always-wins because it makes version pinning impossible; risk accepted that a stale pin silently beats a newer bundle, which requires the .last-record sentinel contract to stay stable (existing warning).
summary: Chose project-local pin precedence (./node_modules/twining-mcp/dist/index.js beats the bundled server) in launch.sh
